pr_title: fix: hide cal branding on platform workflows
query: On our hosted platform the vendor's own name and logo still appear in the messages that automations send out, even for customers whose plan removes it. The setting is read from the wrong place when an automation runs, so what an attendee receives does not match what the same customer sees on the page they book from.
